title: SEO and GEO in Milan: Italian and Export Search | 22 Signals
description: SEO and GEO in Milan for companies selling at home and abroad: rank in Google.it and in English, and be named when buyers ask ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.
h1: SEO and GEO in Milan: get found in Italian, English and AI answers
intro: We run SEO and GEO for Milan companies that need to be found by Italian customers and by buyers abroad. That covers technical fixes, pages planned for real Italian and English searches, local listings, and the signals that decide whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overviews name you when someone asks who to buy from. Reporting is monthly and in plain English.

sections.h: Two markets, two languages, one website
p: Most Milan businesses have two search problems at once. Italian customers search in Italian, on Google.it, with words like 'arredamento su misura' or 'commercialista Milano'. International buyers search in English, German or French for 'Italian furniture manufacturer' or 'Milan textile supplier'. These are different keywords, different competitors and often different pages.

Many sites treat the second market as a translation of the first. Google does not reward that, and buyers notice. Good SEO and GEO in Milan starts by mapping the searches in each market separately, then deciding which pages each one needs.

A small example shows why research matters. Italians search for 'Milano'. English speakers search for 'Milan'. Some international buyers search for 'Milano' because it appears on the label. A page that only uses one spelling misses the others. The same applies across the region: Lombardia and Lombardy, Como and Lake Como, Brianza with no English form at all.
We look at what people actually type, in each language, before writing a single page. Then each language version uses the words its readers use, rather than a literal translation of the Italian.

sections.h: What GEO adds for Italian companies
p: GEO, generative engine optimisation, is the work of getting your company named and described correctly when someone asks an AI assistant a question. A procurement manager in Lyon might ask Gemini for Italian suppliers of industrial valves. A couple in Milan might ask ChatGPT which kitchen showrooms near Porta Romana are worth visiting. The assistant answers with a few names.

Those answers draw on the same foundations as search, plus what other trusted sources say about you: trade directories, industry associations, press coverage, review sites and fair exhibitor lists. For Italian companies, that often means making sure the English description of the business is as complete as the Italian one, because assistants answering in English lean on English sources.

p: Search engines and AI assistants both reward pages that answer questions clearly. In Italian, that means natural Italian, not machine translation with an Italian veneer. Our team delivers strategy, technical work and English content. Italian content is written or reviewed by native partners we arrange, and we brief them with the research, the structure and the facts each page needs.

sections.h: Local search for showrooms and studios
p: Plenty of searches in the city are local. Someone wants a tailor in Brera, an architect near Navigli or a furniture showroom they can visit on Saturday. Google answers those with a map and three businesses. Getting into that map depends on a complete Google Business Profile, the right categories, accurate opening hours, recent photos and a steady flow of genuine reviews.

For companies with more than one location, such as a showroom in the city and a factory outlet in Brianza, each site needs its own profile and its own page with real detail: how to get there, parking, what can be seen on site and who to ask for. We set that up once and keep it accurate.

sections.h: The plan: Talk, Plan, Build, Grow
list: Talk: a 15-minute call about the customers and markets you want more of.
Plan: an audit of your site, listings and presence in AI answers, and a written roadmap ranked by impact, in 5 to 7 days.
Build: technical fixes, new pages, listing clean-up and outreach in priority order, with dates in writing.
Grow: monthly reporting, new content and steady work on outside mentions.

p: We will not promise a set number of AI mentions or a first-page ranking by a date. Nobody controls what an assistant says or what Google ranks. We will not publish dozens of thin pages that swap one Lombardy town name for another, buy links or write reviews. We control the signals and report honestly, including the months that go badly.

sections.h: How we work with Milan clients
p: We do not have an office in Milan. Strategy calls run on Italian time, one hour ahead of London, and reports arrive in writing with a short call to talk them through. We visit when it helps, for example to understand a showroom or meet the export team before a new market push. Because the same company builds websites, runs paid media and makes video, a fix or a new page does not wait for another supplier.

faqs.q: What does SEO and GEO in Milan cost?
faqs.a: It depends on languages, markets, competition and content volume. We price after the audit and set out the monthly scope in writing. There are no long lock-in periods hidden in the contract.

faqs.q: Do we need separate pages for each language?
faqs.a: Yes, for the markets that matter. Each language needs its own pages, written for how people search there, connected with hreflang so Google shows the right version.
Our team delivers in English. Italian content is written or reviewed by native partners we arrange, briefed with our research and structure.

faqs.q: How do AI assistants decide which companies to name?
faqs.a: They draw on your site and, more heavily, on what other trusted sources say about you: directories, reviews, press and industry lists. Consistent, complete descriptions in each language help most.

faqs.q: Can you guarantee we will appear in ChatGPT?
faqs.a: No. Nobody controls an assistant's answers. We track a fixed set of buyer questions every month and improve the signals assistants rely on, and we show you the results honestly.

faqs.q: How long does it take to see results?
faqs.a: Technical fixes show once pages are recrawled. Competitive rankings and regular mentions in AI answers take longer, often several months. We report progress from the first month.
